test_objective: Check that an error is raised if you add an attribute to a temporal entity with invalid content

test_cases.name: 014_02_01 Add an attribute to a temporal representation of an entity with an empty entity id
test_cases.doc: Check that an error is raised if you add a temporal entity attribute with a non-existing/invalid EntityId
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/temporal/entities/{temporal_entity_id}/attrs'
        method set to 'POST'
        Append Attribute to Temporal Entity and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${EMPTY}' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'vehicle-temporal-representation-fragment.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}

test_cases.name: 014_02_02 Add an attribute to a temporal representation of an entity with an invalid entity id
test_cases.doc: Check that an error is raised if you add a temporal entity attribute with a non-existing/invalid EntityId
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/temporal/entities/{temporal_entity_id}/attrs'
        method set to 'POST'
        Append Attribute to Temporal Entity and
    Query Parameter: id set to 'thisIsAninvalidId' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'vehicle-temporal-representation-fragment.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}
